copy.tagline: 设计并分析A/B测试，计算统计显著性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要科学评估不同方案的效果差异
copy.tagline_en: Design and analyze A/B tests with statistical significance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to scientifically evaluate the effect of different variants

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能设计和分析 A/B 测试、计算统计显著性、确定样本量，并生成包含指标、图表和决策建议的总结报告。
howto.when: 当用户需要比较两个版本（如网页、产品功能）的转化率或收入，或验证变更效果时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个A/B测试，对比新旧结账流程的转化率。
say.note: Claude 会询问关键参数并给出设计方案。

say.text: 计算这个实验需要多少样本量，转化率基线10%，目标提升2%。
say.note: Claude 会使用公式计算并给出每组所需样本量。

say.text: 分析这两组数据，看转化率差异是否显著。
say.note: Claude 会执行统计检验并解释结果。

howto.what_en: Claude can design and analyze A/B tests, calculate statistical significance, determine sample sizes, and produce a summary report with metrics, charts, and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to compare two versions (e.g., web pages, product features) on conversion or revenue, or validate the effect of a change.

say_en.text: Design an A/B test comparing the old and new checkout flow for conversion rate.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for key parameters and provide a design plan.

say_en.text: Calculate the sample size needed for this experiment, baseline conversion 10% and target lift 2%.
say_en.note: Claude will compute the required sample per group.

say_en.text: Analyze these two datasets to see if the conversion difference is significant.
say_en.note: Claude will run statistical tests and explain the results.
